vb_textbox.text: The color pairs always remains the same. Purple with orange, red with yellow, brown with green, pink and blue. Sometimes it switches around which gnome gives you more mushrooms. I found that typically purple and brown gave the most out of the rest of the gnomes. Try to keep consistent when you get above 5 mushrooms. If your chosen color drops below 5, see if the other color now is providing more. If not, switch back. It switched about 4 times total for me.
